data.name: Hint
data.value: A PC, a tablet, a mobile phone, a phone subscription or an internet connection the company provides and you also use privately. The company pays what they cost out of its profit, before your pay, and deducts it in full; you are taxed on a flat benefit in kind for each as part of your pay, though it is never paid in cash.

data.name: Remove
data.value: Remove IT and phone from your plan

data.name: PcsHint
data.value: Desktops and laptops the company provides, each valued 72 a year. Beside one, the company pays no computer allowance.

data.name: TabletsHint
data.value: Tablets the company provides, each valued 36 a year. Beside one, the company pays no computer allowance.

data.name: MobilePhonesHint
data.value: The phones themselves the company provides, each valued 36 a year; their subscriptions are counted apart.

data.name: SubscriptionsHint
data.value: Fixed or mobile subscriptions in the company's name, one for each phone number, so each SIM card with its own number counts, each valued 48 a year.

data.name: InternetHint
data.value: An internet connection the company provides, fixed or mobile, valued 60 a year once, whatever the number of connections or of devices using them. Beside it, the company pays no internet allowance.

data.name: CostsHint
data.value: Everything the set costs the company over the year: purchase or lease, subscriptions and connection, as the company bears them.

data.name: ContributionHint
data.value: What you pay the company for the private use of the set, if anything. It comes off the benefit, never more than it.

data.name: ProvidedFromHint
data.value: The first day the set is at your disposal, which counts. Leave it empty if you have had it since the start of the year or before.

data.name: ReturnedOnHint
data.value: The day you give the set back, which does not count. Leave it empty if you keep it beyond the end of the year.

data.name: NoSetYet
data.value: Enter what the company provides to see its figures.

data.name: Help_PieceDays
data.value: {0} a year, taken for the days you have it out of the year's, rounded to the cent for each piece.

data.name: Figure_Benefit
data.value: IT and phone's benefit in kind before your contribution

data.name: Figure_BenefitTaxed
data.value: IT and phone's benefit in kind after your contribution

data.name: Help_BenefitTaxed
data.value: It is taxed as your pay, though never paid in cash.

data.name: Figure_WithEquipment
data.value: Your pocket with the IT and phone

data.name: Help_TaxesOnPay
data.value: On Director pay, where its benefit is taxed with your pay.

data.name: PayHeld
data.value: Both plans run at {0} of pay, the most the company can pay once the set's costs are paid, so the difference is the set's alone.

data.name: PrivateCostHint
data.value: What the same devices, subscriptions and connection would cost you over the year if you bought them yourself.

data.name: Private_Gain
data.value: The company's IT and phone leave you {0} more than buying them yourself.

data.name: Private_Loss
data.value: The company's IT and phone cost you {0} more than buying them yourself.

data.name: Private_Tie
data.value: The company's IT and phone cost you what buying them yourself would.
